email.label: Your email
email.hint: We'll send the confirmation and any host updates here.

register.documentHint: JPEG/PNG/PDF up to 10 MB. Optional for children if host allows.
register.gdprConsent: I agree this guest's personal data is processed for legal registration purposes.

success.alreadyBody: This booking already has a registration on file. If that's wrong, contact your host.
success.heading: Registration received
success.body: Your host will review it shortly. We've emailed you a confirmation.

invalid.heading: Registration link not found
invalid.body: The code in your link doesn't match any booking. Double-check the link your host sent, or reply to their email for a new one.

login.heading: Sign in
login.guestHint: Guest? Use the link your host sent you.

gdpr.heading: Data processing notice
gdpr.body1: When you register for a stay at this property, we collect your name, date of birth (via document type / number), and a photo of your identity document to comply with local short-term-rental guest-reporting laws. Your data is kept for the legally required period and then deleted.
gdpr.body2: If you want to see, correct, or delete your data, contact your host directly — they own this data and act as the controller.

offline.heading: You're offline
offline.body: The app will sync the moment you reconnect. Your previously-loaded tasks stay accessible.
